edition: Nestle-Aland 28 (NA28); German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User explicitly authorized NA28 provisionally on 15 October 2026; UBS6/ECM review remains pending.
scope: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

The single-bracketed before Me (8) and So (39) are retained; the bracketed article at 34 has no independent English equivalent.

chapters.decision: Retained crown/thorns/purple, repeated cries and Pilate’s repeated finding, authority from above, Gabbatha/Golgotha, sixth hour, inscription and three languages, four garment portions, seamless tunic and lots, the women’s names and relationships as supplied, mother/disciple address, thirst/sour wine/hyssop, completion, handed-over spirit, blood/water, bones/piercing, hundred litrai and garden tomb. Modernized selected third-person forms and direct address to Jesus. Verse 31’s long sentence is reordered for speech without losing Preparation, bodies, legs, cross, Sabbath or its greatness. Verse 35 says ‘speaks the truth’. Single-bracketed him (11) and which says (24) remain; articles at 30/38 need no separate English word.

chapters.decision: Preserved Mary’s plural we do not know and later singular I, linen and face cloth distinctions, historical presents, two angels, Rabbouni/Teacher, repeated Father/God possessives, breathing and Spirit, forgiveness/retention perfects, eight days, nail/side repetition, Thomas’s explicit said-to-Him and both my possessives, and the final sign/book purpose. Modernized selected says/has and reordered the doubled-were sentence (19). Mary’s direct speech to Jesus in 15 uses Thou although she thinks He is the gardener; this is the established referent convention, not a claim about her recognition. The bracketed Jesus at 21 remains; bracketed His at 30 is now represented.

chapters.decision: Preserved Tiberias, Didymus, Cana, the two unnamed disciples, fish and charcoal fire, two hundred cubits, 153 fish, the unbroken net, third appearance, threefold questioning, lambs/sheep and feed/shepherd, repeated follow/remain, the corrected rumor and concluding testimony. Selected says/does replace archaic third-person forms; direct address to Jesus uses Thou/Thee. Girding is made explicit as tying a garment (7) and tying a belt (18), retaining the repeated action and another person’s future action without changing it to an explicit binding-for-execution claim. The bracketed Jesus in 17 and final question in 23 remain represented.
